derivation: Simple Ores sells nothing for money: silver and rose gold are found, smelted and crafted; the raw materials and ingots are the currency of crafting, not of trade. IG31-13: the Enderite materials came from SimpleBuilding with their prices (same rows), offered only while Simple Ores is loaded.
